page.heading: Me
page.intro: Your profile, interests, consent and account settings.

common.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
common.signedOutBody: You'll need to sign in again to view or change this.

language.heading: Language
language.intro: The language YourTal shows you. Independent of your region.

autoplay.heading: Autoplay
autoplay.intro: Whether the next video starts on its own when you finish one.

interests.heading: Your interests
interests.intro: Sorts what you see when personalisation, below, is on. Change these any time.

follows.heading: Channels you follow
follows.intro: A private list — used only to sort what you see. Nobody else can see who you follow.
follows.emptyTitle: You're not following any channels yet
follows.emptyBody: Follow a channel from its page to see it here.

consent.heading: Consent
consent.intro: The same choices from sign-up. Turning any of these off is exactly as easy as turning it on.
consent.essentialBody: Keeps your account working and protects it from abuse. Required — it isn't a choice you can turn off separately from deleting your account, below.
consent.personalizeBody: Uses your declared interests, below, to sort what you see. Off, and you still see everything — just not sorted for you.
consent.marketingBody: Messages about new campaigns or promotions, separate from the notifications about points you've actually earned.

security.heading: Password
security.intro: Change the password you sign in with.
security.weakPassword: Your new password needs to be at least 12 characters.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.intro: What YourTal can notify you about.
notifications.pointsUnlockedBody: When points you've earned become available to spend.

linkedApps.heading: Linked apps
linkedApps.intro: Generate a one-time code to link this account in another app.

dataExport.heading: Download my data
dataExport.intro: A copy of the account data YourTal holds about you.

deleteAccount.heading: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: This permanently removes your YourTal account. Before you confirm, here is exactly what happens — there is no cash refund for any of it.
deleteAccount.bulletPoints: Unspent points are forfeited, including anything on hold. None of it can be paid out as cash or transferred to anyone else.
deleteAccount.bulletVouchers: Vouchers already in your wallet keep their code and can still be redeemed by the merchant until they expire — but you won't be able to log back in to view them, so save or screenshot any you plan to use first.
deleteAccount.confirmCheckboxLabel: I understand my unspent points will be forfeited and this can't be undone.
